text:
lisa_support: Hi @eng-security — auditor Claire just submitted a SOC 2 evidence ask for our key management and access logs. They want: (1) KMS/HSM key rotation events for the last 12 months, (2) an example chain-of-custody for an HSM export, (3) an S3 export manifest with checksums, (4) a sampled slice of access logs covering 2025-10-01 -> 2026-02-28, and (5) a small reproducible playbook showing how we trimmed the logs. Link to auditor request: https://auditor.example.com/req/CR-2026-045

omar_security: assigning to me for the security artifacts. Quick q: which KMS aliases map to customer-keystore vs infra-keystore? also do we need the API-layer auth logs alongside KMS decrypt events?

jane_dev: we can produce a manifest under /infra/keystore-exports and include presigned S3 links + sha256 for each file. I'll prepare a sample manifest + a small slice. ETA ~48h.

raj_sre: note — some accesslog shards were archived (90-day hot retention -> then moved to Glacier) in Nov 2025. Restores are required to fetch full JSONL slices; restore time ~6h/day for each archived shard. We should estimate restore cost and include job ids in the evidence.

auditor_claire: Prefer a single evidence bundle (tar.gz) that contains: MANIFEST.txt (file list + sha256), the exported logs (redacted), rotation history CSV/JSON, and a short reproducible playback script. Chain-of-custody should name the operator who initiated the export and object ACLs.

lisa_support: minimal repro snippet for slicing logs — we plan to give this to the auditor: 
```bash
jq -c 'select(.eventName=="Decrypt")' logs-2025-12-*.jsonl | gzip > decrypt-sample.gz
```
We'll attach the manifest to the bundle and include the job id for the export.

omar_security: sample (redacted) log line for reference: 
```jsonl
{"ts":"2025-12-05T13:02:10Z","user":"svc-keystore","event":"Decrypt","key_alias":"alias/customer-prod","request_id":"req-abc123"}
```
We'll strip IPs/emails.

jane_dev: created a temp manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/tmp/exports/2026-03-12/manifest-v1.json sha256: abcdef1234567890... I'll kick off a reproducible export job and record job id: job-2026-0312-77.

raj_sre: FYI restore + export billing estimate for the full 5-month window ~ $120-150. Flagging for finance approval before we proceed with the full set.

lisa_support: auditor Claire — can you confirm acceptable evidence format? Our preference: single tar.gz with MANIFEST.txt containing: file, sha256, created_by, created_at, job_id. Also will you accept redacted logs?

auditor_claire: tar.gz + MANIFEST is OK. Redacted logs are fine as long as you provide a mapping (redaction method) and the rotation history includes timestamps + previous key IDs. Also include the list of staff who had 'key_admin' role during the window.

omar_security: rotation history available via internal endpoint: `/internal/keystore/v1/rotations?start=2025-03-01&end=2026-03-01`. Response includes `rotation_time`, `previous_key_id`, `rotated_by`. We'll mask personal emails in `rotated_by` but will include role/username.

jane_dev: plan of action: (1) produce manifest + single-day example slice (2) include rotation history export (3) raj produce cloud restore playbook + cost breakdown (4) lisa will assemble tar, upload to evidence bucket and share presigned link. Target: Wednesday EOD (48-72h).

jane_dev: on it — ping me if auditor prefers CSV over JSON.

auditor_claire: JSON preferred, CSV acceptable. Please include checksums. Thanks :+1:

evidence_bot: Evidence bundle uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/deliveries/CR-2026-045/manifest-v1.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days).

lisa_support: closing note — I'll follow up with finance and pm for restores. If anything blocks the job ids/manifests I'll post updates here. Thanks everyone.
